_source: Round 25. NWS /alerts/active features in the documented shape (weather.gov/documentation/services-web-api; properties id, @id, areaDesc, geocode {SAME, UGC}, affectedZones, sent, effective, onset, expires, ends, status, messageType, severity, certainty, urgency, event, senderName, headline, description), built from export rows 139787, 139788, 20 and 6468 of gates/r19/data/signals-14d.json (event, areaDesc, senderName, NWS severity/certainty/urgency, url, onset, summary). Codes: the Tornado Watch UGC county codes are the FIPS county numbers of the counties its areaDesc and text name (Palm Beach 12099; Indian River 12061, Martin 12085, Okeechobee 12093, St. Lucie 12111); the zone alerts UGC zone numbers are placeholders in the documented format (zones are never mapped to counties by the code). Variants: -same carries SAME, -nosame has no SAME key.
